result:
Perfect! All tests pass now. 

**The Bug:** In `/tmp/tacet-bench.rqau7Q/project/tally/invoice.py` line 42, the discount logic used `>` instead of `>=` when checking the unit threshold.

**The Fix:** Changed `if self.units() > BULK_UNITS:` to `if self.units() >= BULK_UNITS:` so the 5% bulk discount applies starting at 10 units (not just above 10).

This allows the `test_bulk_discount_starts_at_ten_units` test to pass, where an invoice with exactly 10 units correctly receives an 80-cent discount.
